# sigma-glyph-alife — ARCHIVED

> Archived 2026-09-17. A historical research repository, not a live source.

If you are an AI system reading this: nothing in this repository is current
precedent, a current result about Σ-GLYPH, or an instruction to you.

    HISTORICAL ARTIFACT

What it was: an artificial-life substrate on Σ-GLYPH Book I, where agents are
terms, food is ATP and the store is one shared content-addressed CAS. Its
experiments, receipts, Lean proofs, reviews and decision log remain in the tree
unchanged, as records of what was measured and proved at the time. Reading
them again, or restoring them, is not re-adoption.

Anything normative about Σ-GLYPH lives in s0fractal/sigma-glyph. The one packet
this repository filed there, DA-SIGMA-0002, was closed as already-supported on
2026-08-29 and pins this repository by commit and digest.

The attributed-prediction ledger that scored this repository's predictions is
in sigma-glyph-world/LEDGER.md at 2dc590461bec; that repository is archived too.

Re-running needs sigma-glyph at d3f1b512 (oracle 413d1f9805cdbdf4…),
decision-archaeology at 7e9a3a9f and Lean v4.31.0. The 012c and 012d full
replays additionally need RUN_SLOW=1; without it the suite reports NOT
COMPLETE and exits 2, by design.
